{{Quote|Whether it's a warm day or you simply sat next to a combusting Immolanoid during the morning commute, there's no better way to cool off than one of our ice cream treats.|From the menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex's" />}}
The '''Immolanoids''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that were known to combust and that lived and commuted on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dex's" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] mentioned the species in the [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] section of the menu for his Coruscant [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]].<ref name="Dex's" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Immolanoids were first mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="Dex's" />
